title: Commissions
description: Commission per sales employee, worked out from the Performance reports and sick notes.
emptyBody: The sales dashboard has no employees for this month. Reports are uploaded under Performance.
running: This month is still running – totals change with every new report upload.
detailHealthyUnknown: No linked intranet person – sick notes unknown.
detailHealthyStreak: {months, plural, =0 {Sick last month} one {# previous month without a sick note} other {# previous months in a row without a sick note}} (bonus from {every}).
ruleTier: Per closed won in the month: 1st–24th included, 25th–30th €10 each, 31st–40th €20 each, from the 41st €25 each (40 deals = €260).
ruleWeek: €50 per calendar week (Mon–Sun) with at least 15 closed won. A week counts in the month of its Thursday.
ruleMonth: €50 for more than 60 closed won in the month.
ruleHitrate: €50 for a monthly hit rate of 25 % or more (closed won ÷ workables).
ruleHealthy: €100 every month in which the 3 previous months had no sick note (time tracking).
